---
title: "About me"
description: |
 Since I was a young, I’ve always been the person to spend extra time on the trailhead staring at the structure of a trees leaf, or watching a bee pollinate a flower, as my family continued to walk, leaving me in the distance. This passion for nature is what has guided me down the path of biological studies. As I studied at Utah Valley University, I began to narrow my passion to understanding ecological systems and how evolutionary processes have led to the formation of such ecosystems. I have now graduated with a Bachelor’s in Biology, and hope next obtain a PhD degree. I have recently obtained GIS certification and will next acheive MLT certification. I hope to continue to study the various processes that make our world so beautiful and worthy of spending a few extra minutes on the trailhead.
---
